title.th: คำสั่งการตีความ (การสำแดงศุลกากร — ค่าธรรมเนียม) 2012

completenessNote: 全文，共 3 条；逐字取自新加坡法规在线（SSO）官方打印视图，未改写、未节选。

text.en: 1. This Order may be cited as the Interpretation (Customs Declaration — Fees) Order 2012 and shall be deemed to have come into operation on 30th October 2007.
3. The Director-General of Customs may, in any particular case, remit wholly or in part any fee payable under paragraph 2.
